headline: 3i Infotech posts Q2 FY27 revenue of Rs 182 crore, up 4.1% year-on-year
summary: 3i Infotech Limited has released its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company reported a total revenue of Rs 182.0 crore, marking a 4.1% increase compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year. This corporate update was officially communicated to the stock exchanges via a press release dated October 29, 2026. Retail shareholders can assess the modest top-line expansion against broader IT sector performance trends.
why_it_matters: Modest revenue uptick signals steady but slow operational progress.

headline: 3i Infotech appoints Shirsendu Chaudhuri as Senior Management Personnel
hook: New growth head joins leadership team
summary: 3i Infotech Limited has announced the appointment of Shirsendu Chaudhuri, its current Chief Growth Officer, as a Senior Management Personnel effective October 29, 2026. This internal appointment adds to the senior leadership roster responsible for driving the company's expansion strategy. For an Indian retail investor, routine management updates for micro-cap IT firms like 3i Infotech typically have minimal immediate impact on stock price or business performance.
why_it_matters: Routine management changes rarely move micro-cap stock prices.

headline: 3i Infotech discloses pendency of litigation and disputes affecting the company
hook: Legal disputes active for IT firm
summary: 3i Infotech Limited has formally notified the stock exchanges regarding the pendency of ongoing litigations and disputes that could impact its business operations.
